{"script":"cat > count_files.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
# Usage: ./count_files.sh [directory]
# Counts regular files inside subdirectories of the given directory (default: test_directory)

dir="${1:-test_directory}"
if [ ! -d "$dir" ]; then
  echo "Directory '$dir' not found" >&2
  exit 1
fi

# Count regular files in all subdirectories (any depth), excluding files directly in $dir
find "$dir" -mindepth 2 -type f | wc -l
EOF

chmod +x count_files.sh

echo "Created ./count_files.sh""}
